## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what's missing or awkward about the current API?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen. Sample code or an API sketch helps.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches or workarounds you've tried.

## Additional context

Note that this project is intentionally small and dependency-free (see the "Scope" section
in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)) — requests that add a runtime dependency or
change how existing consent is stored need a strong justification.
